item.title: Japanese Idol Forced to Choose Between Fan Relationship & Career
item.description: A 20-year-old Japanese idol has issued a tearful public apology after admitting to privately communicating with a fan, revealing that her agency gave her an ultimatum: cut ties with the individual or abandon her idol career.

item.title: Bandai Namco Suffers Cyberattack, Customer Data Potentially Leaked
item.description: Japanese entertainment giant Bandai Namco has suffered a cyberattack targeting one of its logistics subsidiaries, potentially exposing the personal information of customers using its popular Ichiban Kuji Online lottery service.

item.title: Action Taimanin Gets Allegedly Uncensored Release on FETAMIX
item.description: Action Taimanin has officially launched on FETAMIX, a new third-party gaming platform, offering players an alternative to Google Play’s restrictive content policies after the popular action RPG previously faced censorship and the removal of numerous revealing outfits.

item.title: Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi o Suru’s Marin Gets Spectacular $8,000 Life-Sized Figure
item.description: The beautiful Marin Kitagawa from Sono Bisque Doll wa Koi o Suru is receiving a life-sized figure that allows fans to dress the popular anime heroine in either her school uniform or a revealing swimsuit, although bringing the cosplay-loving girl home will cost an eye-watering ¥1.32 million ($8,600).

item.title: World of Warcraft: Forever Censors Breast Jiggle Physics
item.description: Blizzard has attracted criticism from World of Warcraft fans after comparisons between WoW Classic and the upcoming World of Warcraft: Forever revealed that female characters have lost much of their original breast jiggle physics.

item.title: Guilty Gear Strive Bridget Birthday Post Labels the Character a “She”
item.description: Arc System Works has once again reignited controversy surrounding Guilty Gear Strive character Bridget, as a birthday celebration referring to the male character as female attracted numerous Twitter users expressing their displeasure as this forced narrative.

item.title: Ocarina of Time Remake’s Great Fairy All Covered Up
item.description: Nintendo’s upcoming The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake has attracted criticism over changes to the Great Fairy’s famously revealing appearance, with some accusing the company of censoring the character in its modernized version of the Nintendo 64 classic.

item.title: Sony Data Breach Exposes 2.58 Million Accounts & Thousands of Passwords
item.description: Sony Network Communications has suffered a massive data breach affecting approximately 2.58 million customer records, with hackers obtaining personal information, thousands of email passwords, and even a small number of bank account details.

item.title: Zero Escape Creator Says Rejecting AI Could Hurt Game Developers
item.description: Zero Escape creator Kotaro Uchikoshi has defended the use of generative AI in video game development, suggesting that the technology could have helped save a recently canceled project at his new studio, Crash Keys, by reducing production costs and development time.

item.title: Amazon Flooded With Suspected AI-Generated Fire Emblem Guides
item.description: Nintendo’s Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave has become the latest video game targeted by publishers selling suspicious strategy guides on Amazon Japan, with numerous unofficial books featuring seemingly AI-generated artwork and questionable contents appearing just weeks after the game’s release.

item.title: Final Fantasy Veteran Says AI Can’t Replace Human Creativity
item.description: Veteran Final Fantasy developer Yoshinori Kitase believes artificial intelligence will become increasingly important in video game development, but insists that the technology should never replace the human creativity responsible for coming up with original ideas.
